name: Samophlange
summary: At the Sludge Fen, Samophlange machinery sits idle, its pressure relieved and valves shut. Tinkerer Sniggles holds the key to open the control unit and free the samophlange within.

sections.title: Unlocking the Mechanism
sections.body: You have turned the auxiliary valves and relieved the pressure. The dials and gauges have settled, but the housing remains locked against tampering. The goblin engineer overseeing the drilling site holds its key.

sections.title: Tinkerer Sniggles
sections.body: Tinkerer Sniggles oversees the Venture Company’s equipment at the Sludge Fen. His hut lies just northeast of the main rig, and he keeps the console key there. You need it to open the housing and reach the samophlange.

sections.title: Power Drain
sections.body: Turning Sniggles’ key in the console unlatches the housing. The red beacon goes dark, and the electrical hum fades. With the console’s safeguards disengaged, the core is ready to be removed.

faq.answer: Tinkerer Sniggles is in a goblin hut just northeast of the main control console at the Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens.

faq.q: What is the Console Key used for?
faq.answer: The Console Key unlocks the main control terminal at the Sludge Fen and cuts the remaining power. Then you can remove the samophlange inside.

faq.q: Why did the console need to be shut down before using the key?
faq.answer: The apparatus valves had to be vented first so the machinery would idle. Handling it under full pressure would be hazardous.

faq.q: Who does Tinkerer Sniggles work for?
faq.answer: Tinkerer Sniggles works for the Venture Company, which trades and extracts resources across the northern Barrens.
A samophlange is a complex engineering component used in the Venture Company’s heavy drilling and pumping machinery.

faq.q: What happens after using the key on the console?
faq.answer: Using the key unlocks the terminal and cuts its power. The warning lights go dark, and you can remove the samophlange.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see how idling the gauges before opening the housing follows goblin mechanical safety practice.
As a member of the Horde, you help slow the Venture Company’s exploitation and toxic runoff across northern Kalimdor by sabotaging its equipment at the Sludge Fen.
